purpose: Single project-wide font identity for every Chinese story, UI, atlas, canary and future battle-dialogue asset. Scene profiles continue to own their raster geometry and byte budget.

unsupported_character_fallbacks.reason: HarmonyOS Sans SC 1.0 has no visible glyph for these project-required characters. Use the locked Noto source only for this explicit set and retain the consuming scene's raster geometry.
